# Media dependencies

The project bundles these headers so wallpaper and boot audio need no extra downloads:

- `stb/stb_image.h`: stb_image 2.30 from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb/tree/f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5), commit `f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5`. JPEG/PNG decoding. Dual MIT/public-domain license is included in the header.
- `miniaudio/miniaudio.h`: [miniaudio 0.11.21](https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio/tree/0.11.21). MP3 decoding and background audio playback. Dual MIT-0/public-domain license is included in the header.
